reference.question: The graph of \(y=k/x\) passes through the point \((2,3)\). What is \(k\)?
reference.solution:
Method 1: Substitute the given point

Substitute \(x=2\) and \(y=3\) into \(y=k/x\) to obtain \(k=xy=2\times3=6\).
